status: Embedded local custody candidate; supported embedded Service consent and live acceptance pending

wallet.patch: Two TypeScript-only non-null assertions on validated base64 character indexes for noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No runtime behavior change. Attribution header corrected to the public source repository and pinned path; tests reconstruct upstream bytes including the historical header before verifying the original Git blob.

security: Wallet owns private keys, issuer signature verification, replay protection and explicit origin-bound consent.
Anima checks returned field bindings and account continuity; it does not declare membership verified or workspace authority from these claims.
Receiver key roots, exact origin and endpoint are reviewed configuration. Discovery cannot install trust.

No default provider, silent identity creation, fallback signer, plaintext private-key persistence, or automatic enrollment. User-reviewed local identity creation is implemented through Castalia RecoverySession.

qualification.scope: Pinned source/type compatibility and explicit callback/signature fixtures. Historical consumer counts are not a standalone release qualification.
qualification.embeddedLocalCustody: Implemented candidate; standalone create/restore, recovery download and verification require browser regression review.
qualification.consentGate: Producer-supported embedded Service consent adapter sharing the existing RecoverySession is required. No extension fallback or second signer.
qualification.sealerRuntime: Not included or configured; see SEALER-SOURCE.json.

embedded.scope: User-reviewed local create/restore, unlock/lock, encrypted recovery export and exact-identity backup verification. No membership, enrollment, authenticated session or provider authority is inferred.
embedded.compatibility: Additive origin-local store; existing drafts, references, extension custody and older Castalia web storage are untouched. Portable .castalia-recovery format is produced and validated by shared Rust.
embedded.missing: Producer-supported credential_presentation_v2 facade sharing RecoverySession custody, backup verification, approved trust and epoch. No speculative second signer.
